messages:
Sam Yang: Heads up — new RFI from TidalHealth just landed. They want a capability matrix, a POC within ~3 weeks, pricing bands (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and a completed security questionnaire (they attached a PDF). Can we triage? Attached: tidal_rfi_questionnaire.pdf

Jess Patel: On it. Quick clarifying Q — do they require on-prem (air-gapped) or will a managed VPC + HSM satisfy them? That changes both pricing and POC time.

Maria Gómez: Their note says 'managed VPC with HSM integration preferred; on-prem if required for certification'. I can run the Dedicated POC but will need exact KMS/HSM integration details.

Connor Li: For HSM support we offer: Cloud KMS for Hosted/Dedicated, and PKCS#11 HSM gateway for Private. Need to confirm scope: are they asking for PCI-level segmentation or broader FedRAMP?

Sam Yang: @Connor Li they specifically called out PCI DSS for cardholder flows and asked for audit artifacts within 30 days.

Security Bot: Security checklist quick scan: SOC2 Type II — yes (we can share redacted report). Last external pen-test — 2024-09 (report redacted). Recommend sending "security-answers.xlsx" with per-question references. I can attach SOC2-snapshot.pdf and pen-test-redacted.pdf.

Jess Patel: I'll build the capability matrix. Proposed columns: Feature | Hosted API | Dedicated | Private | Notes. Initial rows: latency SLA, throughput (TPS), data residency, KMS/HSM support, SOC2, pen-test, canary rollouts, model pinning/versioning, support SLA. Add anything?

Maria Gómez: Add 'data purge API' and 'model verifiability / fingerprinting' — Tidal will care about lineage.

Connor Li: Draft POC ops plan (high level):
```
1) Provision Dedicated pool (4x A100 equiv)
2) Deploy customer model v1.2 (quantized)
3) Run 48-hour soak + synthetic 99th-latency and throughput tests
4) Validate KV cache warmup and cold-start latencies
5) Deliver logs to their SIEM (S3 -> secure transfer)
Estimated infra lead time: ~10 business days once approved
```

Sam Yang: Pricing ask — they want ballpark tiers A/B/C with assumptions. I'll include Hosted per-token ranges, Dedicated reserved monthly ranges, and Private one-time + ops. @Jess can you include concurrency and sequence-length assumptions in the footnote?

Jess Patel: Yep. I'll draft price bands and assumptions. I'll drop two files when ready: tidal_capability_matrix.xlsx and tidal_pricing_ranges.pdf.

Connor Li: Action items: @Jess draft matrix + pricing (EOD Thu), @Maria runbook + infra estimate (Fri), @Security Bot compile questionnaire answers + attach audited artifacts (Thu). I'll stand by for HSM integration checklist.

Security Bot: Uploaded attachments to thread: SOC2-snapshot.pdf, pen-test-redacted.pdf, security-answers.xlsx. Also note: we redact any customer-sensitive findings.

Sam Yang: :thumbsup: Thanks. Let's sync 9am tomorrow if we need to reconcile gaps before sending. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly.
